subject: Novum pilot — PO routing, legal & security deliverables
messages:
From: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@novumhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novumhealth.com
Date: 2027-05-30T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Novum pilot — initial vendor prerequisites and PO template
Attachments: Novum_PO_template.xlsx (xlsx)

Hi Sergio / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the pilot looked promising and my product team is excited to move to a short pilot next month. Procurement asked me to gather a small set of artifacts up front so they can open a vendor record and route a PO:

- SOC 2 attestation or summary
- ISO 27001 certificate (if available)
- Recent pen-test letter or summary of 3rd-party assessments
- Completed vendor onboarding form (their vendor intake)
- Standard PO terms (they shared the attached PO template)

Can Redwood provide a single package with the items above? Procurement will also need a contact for the security questionnaire if they have follow-ups.

We'd like to have the procurement file started by next Wednesday to keep the pilot timeline. If helpful, happy to do a 20-minute call to walk through the PO path.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Gomez
Procurement Manager | Novum Health
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novum pilot — initial vendor prerequisites and PO template
Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (pdf); redwood_iso27001_cert.pdf (pdf); redwood_pen_test_letter.pdf (pdf); vendor_onboarding_form.docx (docx); redwood_po_terms.pdf (pdf); redwood_dpa_draft.pdf (pdf)

Hi Marta — great to hear the pilot is moving forward.

I've pulled together the compliance artifacts we commonly provide: SOC 2 summary (redacted report summary), ISO 27001 certificate, and our most recent pen-test letter. I'm attaching our vendor onboarding form and our standard PO terms for your procurement team to review. I also included a draft DPA for legal if that helps speed things up.

Quick notes / asks:
- Does Novum accept a SOC 2 summary + ISO certificate, or do you need the full SOC report under NDA?
- Our standard payment terms are Net 30. We can discuss alternatives if Novum requires Net 45 or specific milestone billing.
- Please confirm the procurement contact who will own vendor profile creation; I'll follow up directly with them.

I've CC'd Rishi from our procurement/compliance team for any detailed evidence questions and to coordinate the vendor intake workflow on our side. If procurement prefers, we can run a 20-minute sync later today.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf; redwood_iso27001_cert.pdf; redwood_pen_test_letter.pdf; vendor_onboarding_form.docx; redwood_po_terms.pdf; redwood_dpa_draft.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@novumhealth.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novum pilot — initial vendor prerequisites and PO template

Hi Marta — looping in with procurement details from our side.

Thanks for the template. A few clarifications that help expedite vendor activation: 
1) Evidence: the SOC 2 summary we sent usually satisfies initial vendor screening; for contract execution we sometimes provide the full SOC 2 report under a mutual NDA. If Novum requires the unredacted report please let us know and we can route the NDA.
2) Additional docs procurement often requests: vendor bank details (for ACH), completed W-9 (or W-8 if outside US), and a vendor profile form. I attached our onboarding form — please fill sections A/B and return.
3) PO path: once the PO is issued against our vendor record the finance team processes in 5–7 business days; Net 30 applies from invoice date. If you need a billing contact to route invoices, send that to finance@redwood.com.

If procurement wants to review the security questionnaire, we can assign a member of our security team; otherwise I can manage the intake and route any technical follow-ups to security.

Proposed next steps:
- Marta to confirm whether full SOC report is necessary or summary is OK (by EOD tomorrow)
- Novum to return completed onboarding form + W-9
- If PO terms need negotiation, schedule a short call this week

Happy to jump on a 20-min sync — Sergio, Laura, let me know your availability.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Procurement & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@novumhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novumhealth.com
Date: 2027-05-30T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novum pilot — initial vendor prerequisites and PO template

Sergio / Rishi — thanks for the fast turnaround and for bundling the artifacts.

Procurement confirms a SOC 2 summary is acceptable to start the profile; they may request the full SOC 2 under NDA closer to contracting. I'm attaching the internal vendor intake contact: Jaime Li (jaime.li@novumhealth.com). Jaime will fill your vendor onboarding form and return with a completed W-9.

Let's do a 20-min call tomorrow 09:00 PT to walk through the PO template and confirm billing contact. Does that work for you?

I appreciate the DPA draft — legal will take a look and route any changes via DocuSign.

Best,
Marta
Marta Gomez
Procurement Manager | Novum Health
